notes: Restricted review sites are intentionally blocked from automated collection.
Apple App Store ratings are collected through Apple's official Search/Lookup API and are labeled as mobile-app sentiment, not whole-platform sentiment.
A mobile-app rating can produce a Provisional EZ Score, but a Live EZ Score requires at least two independent evidence sources and the configured minimum component count.
TrustRadius API support is available in the refresh script when TRUSTRADIUS_API_KEY and per-product slugs are configured.
JSON-LD aggregateRating scraping is permitted only for explicitly configured allowlisted pages after robots.txt permits access.
Missing evidence produces Collecting data / Insufficient data, never an invented rating.
